sink.preCopyScript: IF OBJECT_ID('staging.shipment_updates','U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE staging.shipment_updates (import_run_id bigint NOT NULL, source_row_no int NOT NULL, shipment_id nvarchar(30), customer_name nvarchar(120), product_name nvarchar(120), facility_name nvarchar(120), carrier_name nvarchar(120), dock_code nvarchar(20), planned_departure_utc datetime2(0), ordered_qty decimal(18,3), shipped_qty decimal(18,3), freight_cost decimal(18,2), status nvarchar(30), validation_error nvarchar(500)); TRUNCATE TABLE staging.shipment_updates;
